title: Google Workspace Migrate — Deployment & Large-Scale Migration Execution
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Run large-scale M365→Google migrations with Google Workspace Migrate
problem: For enterprise-scale file and mailbox moves, Google Workspace Migrate is Google's native large-scale tool — but it needs node infrastructure, connections, and mappings designed correctly. This solution is the deployment + execution playbook: stand up the Migrate platform (nodes/database), connect Microsoft 365 and Google, build mappings and bridges, run scoped migration waves with throttling, and validate results — so SharePoint/OneDrive and mail move at scale, reliably.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Google Workspace Migrate architecture (nodes, database, connections, mappings/bridges), where it fits vs other tools, and the wave model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (node infrastructure sizing, M365 + Google admin access/scopes, network, pilot scope).

Implementation Guide — deploy the platform, configure connections + mappings, run a pilot wave with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; tool-console internals deferred to Google's Migrate docs, procedure and sequencing given.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (pilot migrated + validated, throttling stable, error rate within threshold) plus Best Practices for large-scale wave execution.
short: Deploy and execute with Google Workspace Migrate — node platform, M365 + Google connections, mappings/bridges, throttled migration waves, and validation — so large-scale file and mail migrations run reliably. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
